label: Roads, footpaths
responsible_desk: GMDA for master roads, MCG for internal roads
owns: GMDA owns the master roads between sectors and the major corridors. MCG owns internal roads, lanes and footpaths. HSVP keeps its own sectors until transfer; developers keep licensed colonies under DTCP. NH-48 and the expressways are NHAI.
channels: Portal: GMDA integrated grievance portal (https://services.gmda.gov.in/) | Toll-free: 1800 180 1817 (tel:18001801817) | WhatsApp: 78400 01817, with a photo (https://wa.me/917840001817) | App: myGurugram | Highways: NHAI 1033 (tel:1033)
ladder: Ticket on the portal; keep the number. Only you can close it. | No action in time: the officer named on the ticket, then the zone Joint Commissioner or Executive Engineer. | Still pending: MCG Commissioner and Mayor, or GMDA CEO. | Final: CM Window, with every ticket number attached.

label: Garbage
owns: Door-to-door collection, sweeping, collection points, bulk waste and debris. Societies producing 100 kg a day or more must process wet waste on site under the 2016 rules.
channels: Portal: GMDA integrated grievance portal (https://services.gmda.gov.in/) | Toll-free: 1800 180 1817 (tel:18001801817) | WhatsApp: 78400 01817, with a photo (https://wa.me/917840001817) | App: myGurugram | Central record: Swachhata app (https://swachhbharaturban.gov.in/)
ladder: Ticket on the portal or the Swachhata app; keep the number. | Not attended: the ward sanitary inspector, then the zone Joint Commissioner. | Still pending: MCG Commissioner and Mayor. | Final: CM Window with the ticket history.

label: Water, sewer
responsible_desk: GMDA for bulk supply, MCG for distribution
owns: GMDA runs the treatment plants, master water lines and master sewers. MCG owns distribution and internal sewers inside sectors; HSVP in its own sectors. Tankers during a shortage come through the same ticket.
channels: Portal: GMDA integrated grievance portal (https://services.gmda.gov.in/) | Toll-free: 1800 180 1817 (tel:18001801817) | WhatsApp: 78400 01817, with a photo (https://wa.me/917840001817) | App: myGurugram
ladder: Ticket on the portal; keep the number. Only you can close it. | No action in time: the officer named on the ticket, then the zone Joint Commissioner or Executive Engineer. | Still pending: MCG Commissioner and Mayor, or GMDA CEO. | Final: CM Window, with every ticket number attached.

label: Drains, flooding
responsible_desk: GMDA for master drains, MCG for internal drains
owns: GMDA owns the master storm drains and natural creeks. MCG owns internal drains, desilting and road gullies. In the monsoon the district control room coordinates emergency pumping.
channels: Portal: GMDA integrated grievance portal (https://services.gmda.gov.in/) | Toll-free: 1800 180 1817 (tel:18001801817) | WhatsApp: 78400 01817, with a photo (https://wa.me/917840001817) | App: myGurugram | District: Control room and helplines (https://gurugram.gov.in/helpline/)
ladder: Ticket on the portal; keep the number. Only you can close it. | No action in time: the officer named on the ticket, then the zone Joint Commissioner or Executive Engineer. | Still pending: MCG Commissioner and Mayor, or GMDA CEO. | Final: CM Window, with every ticket number attached.

label: Streetlights
responsible_desk: MCG for internal roads, GMDA for master roads
owns: Dark stretches, faulty poles and timers on internal roads are MCG; on sector-dividing and master roads they are GMDA. Quote the pole number if it is painted on.
channels: Portal: GMDA integrated grievance portal (https://services.gmda.gov.in/) | Toll-free: 1800 180 1817 (tel:18001801817) | WhatsApp: 78400 01817, with a photo (https://wa.me/917840001817) | App: myGurugram
ladder: Ticket on the portal; keep the number. Only you can close it. | No action in time: the officer named on the ticket, then the zone Joint Commissioner or Executive Engineer. | Still pending: MCG Commissioner and Mayor, or GMDA CEO. | Final: CM Window, with every ticket number attached.

label: Parks, trees
responsible_desk: MCG horticulture; HSVP in its sectors; Forest Department for trees
owns: Neighbourhood parks are MCG horticulture. Green belts along HSVP roads are HSVP. Felling or damaging a tree needs Forest Department permission; report illegal felling to the Forest Department and the police.
channels: Portal: GMDA integrated grievance portal (https://services.gmda.gov.in/) | Toll-free: 1800 180 1817 (tel:18001801817) | WhatsApp: 78400 01817, with a photo (https://wa.me/917840001817) | App: myGurugram
ladder: Ticket on the portal; keep the number. Only you can close it. | No action in time: the officer named on the ticket, then the zone Joint Commissioner or Executive Engineer. | Still pending: MCG Commissioner and Mayor, or GMDA CEO. | Final: CM Window, with every ticket number attached.

label: Traffic
responsible_desk: Gurugram Traffic Police; GMDA for signals
owns: Enforcement, wrong-side driving and parking are the Traffic Police. Faulty signals, signage and junction design are GMDA. Vendors and structures on roads are MCG enforcement.
channels: Emergency: 112 (tel:112) | Police: Haryana Police portal (https://haryanapolice.gov.in/) | Signals: GMDA integrated portal (https://services.gmda.gov.in/) | Toll-free: 1800 180 1817 (tel:18001801817)
ladder: Traffic Police for enforcement; a GMDA ticket for signals and engineering. | Not attended: the ACP Traffic of the zone, then the DCP Traffic. | Still pending: the Commissioner of Police, Gurugram. | Final: CM Window, or a Forum policy dialogue for a recurring junction.

label: Electricity
owns: Outages, tripping, broken poles, meter faults and billing disputes. Restoration and meter timelines are set by the Haryana Electricity Regulatory Commission.
ladder: Register on 1912 or the portal; keep the complaint number. | Not resolved: the SDO (Operation), then the Executive Engineer. | Still pending: the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum, DHBVN. | Final: the Electricity Ombudsman, Haryana.

label: Air, noise
owns: Construction dust, industrial emissions, noise and waste burning. Burning on public land is also MCG. Under GRAP, the Commission for Air Quality Management sets NCR-wide restrictions.
channels: Central app: Sameer (CPCB) (https://cpcb.nic.in/) | State board: HSPCB (https://hspcb.gov.in/) | Portal: GMDA portal, air-monitoring cell (https://services.gmda.gov.in/) | Toll-free: 1800 180 1817 (tel:18001801817)
ladder: Complaint on Sameer or the GMDA portal, with photo and time. | Not attended: the HSPCB Regional Officer, Gurugram. | Still pending: Member Secretary, HSPCB, and the Deputy Commissioner. | Final: CM Window, or CPGRAMS for CPCB and CAQM.

label: Stray animals
owns: Stray dog sterilisation and vaccination, stray cattle, carcass removal and dog-bite follow-up.
channels: Portal: GMDA integrated grievance portal (https://services.gmda.gov.in/) | Toll-free: 1800 180 1817 (tel:18001801817) | WhatsApp: 78400 01817, with a photo (https://wa.me/917840001817) | App: myGurugram
ladder: Ticket on the portal; keep the number. Only you can close it. | No action in time: the officer named on the ticket, then the zone Joint Commissioner or Executive Engineer. | Still pending: MCG Commissioner and Mayor, or GMDA CEO. | Final: CM Window, with every ticket number attached.

label: Illegal construction
responsible_desk: MCG town planning; DTCP for licensed colonies; HSVP in its sectors
owns: Unauthorised floors, commercial use of residential plots and encroachment inside municipal limits are MCG. Licensed private colonies are the District Town Planner. HSVP sectors are the HSVP Estate Officer.
channels: Portal: GMDA integrated grievance portal (https://services.gmda.gov.in/) | Toll-free: 1800 180 1817 (tel:18001801817) | WhatsApp: 78400 01817, with a photo (https://wa.me/917840001817) | App: myGurugram | DTCP: Town and Country Planning (https://tcpharyana.gov.in/) | HSVP: HSVP (https://hsvphry.org.in/)
ladder: Written complaint with photos, plus a ticket on the portal. | Not attended: Senior Town Planner (MCG) or District Town Planner (DTCP). | Still pending: MCG Commissioner or Director, Town and Country Planning. | Final: CM Window.

label: Property tax
owns: Property-tax assessment and correction, building plans, occupation and no-dues certificates. Most are notified services with fixed time limits under the Right to Service Act.
channels: Portal: ULB property tax and services (https://ulbhryndc.org/) | Services: Saral Haryana (https://saralharyana.gov.in/) | MCG: mcg.gov.in (https://www.mcg.gov.in/)
ladder: Apply online; keep the application number. | Past the notified limit: the Auto Appeal System escalates for you. | Still pending: Grievance Officer, then the Right to Service Commission. | Parallel route: CM Window.

label: Builders, societies
owns: Delayed possession and defects go to HRERA. Maintenance handover and licence conditions are DTCP. Disputes inside an RWA or AOA go to the District Registrar under the 2012 Act.
channels: HRERA: HRERA Gurugram (https://haryanarera.gov.in/) | DTCP: Town and Country Planning (https://tcpharyana.gov.in/) | District: District Registrar, Firms and Societies (https://gurugram.gov.in/)
ladder: File with HRERA or DTCP with the agreement and payment record. | HRERA: appeal to the Real Estate Appellate Tribunal. | DTCP: Director, Town and Country Planning, then CM Window. | Society-wide patterns go to a Forum policy dialogue.

label: Police, cyber
owns: Crime, harassment, threats, domestic violence and cyber fraud. Any station must register a Zero FIR for a cognisable offence; you get a free copy of the FIR.
channels: Emergency: 112 (tel:112) | Women: 181 (tel:181) | Cyber fraud: 1930, within the first hour (tel:1930) | Portal: cybercrime.gov.in (https://cybercrime.gov.in/) | Police: Haryana Police (https://haryanapolice.gov.in/)
ladder: 112 in an emergency; otherwise the station or online. | FIR refused: written complaint to the DCP of the zone. | Still refused: Commissioner of Police, or the Judicial Magistrate. | Cyber fraud: 1930 first, then the portal, then the station.

label: Consumer
responsible_desk: National Consumer Helpline; District Commission, Gurugram
owns: Defective goods, unfair charges, deficient services, online disputes. The District Commission hears claims up to 50 lakh rupees; the State Commission up to 2 crore.
channels: Helpline: 1915 (tel:1915) | Portal: consumerhelpline.gov.in (https://consumerhelpline.gov.in/) | File online: e-Daakhil (https://edaakhil.nic.in/)
ladder: Written complaint to the seller; keep the record. | No resolution: 1915 mediation with the company. | Still unresolved: District Commission, Gurugram, on e-Daakhil. | Appeal to the State Commission, Panchkula.

label: RTI
responsible_desk: The Public Information Officer of that office
owns: Any record a public authority holds: files, tenders, inspection reports, budgets. Reply due in 30 days, 48 hours where life or liberty is at stake.
channels: Central: RTI Online (https://rtionline.gov.in/) | State: PIO of MCG, GMDA, HSVP or DTCP, with a 10 rupee fee
ladder: Application to the PIO with the fee. | No reply in 30 days: first appeal in the same office. | Second appeal: State Information Commission (CIC for central bodies). | The Forum can help draft a precise request.

label: Something else
responsible_desk: Depends on the subject; the Forum maps it
owns: A scheme not reaching you, a service that needs redesign, an idea for the city. The Forum reads every submission and points it to a desk or a policy dialogue.
channels: State: CM Window (https://cmharyanacell.nic.in/) | Central: CPGRAMS (https://pgportal.gov.in/) | Forum: Report it here (#/report)
ladder: Send it through the Forum. | A volunteer maps it within three working days. | Recurring themes go to a policy dialogue.
